sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your counter-offer and the proposed 24-month contract term, which we welcome as it provides valuable stability for both of our companies. Our family foundry has always valued long-term partnerships in our region, and working together for two decades means a great deal to our team.

In recognition of our long-standing partnership and the extended contract duration, we are prepared to revise our offer to €51.30.

Our Angebot is a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation and standing by your side as a reliable partner.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. Having already adjusted our price to €51.30 per unit in recognition of the 24-month contract, we are unable to make further concessions without a corresponding step from your side. We kindly ask you to reconsider our current offer, which reflects a fair and sustainable basis for our continued partnership.

For your reference, our current offer stands at a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our family foundry values the long relationship we share with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, and we hope to continue this tradition together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to deal with our valued partners at Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. As a family-run foundry, we deeply cherish our long-standing regional ties and shared history. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

As a family-run foundry, we have already made a significant concession to €51.30 per unit to reflect the contract term of 24 months. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €51.30 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and is valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We must respectfully insist on a reciprocal step from your side before we can consider any further adjustments. Our dedication to quality and craftsmanship remains as steadfast as ever, and we trust you understand our position as we seek a fair balance for both of our traditional businesses.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to work with your valued company, and we look back proudly on our long standing relationship. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Ourangebot stands at a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

As we have already made a significant concession to €51.30 for the 24-month contract, we cannot move further without a reciprocal step from your side. We kindly request a meeting to discuss how we can bridge this gap and find a mutually beneficial agreement. Our family foundry values the strong bond we share, and we hope to continue our successful collaboration.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
